verdict.line: You lose if you trade into wall-side Tentacles before level 6; you win if you reach your tank core and hold R (All Out) for the right moment, where K'Sante carries a 58.8% head-to-head win rate over 34 games despite the lane shape favoring Illaoi.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's damage and sustain are tied to Tentacles, which only spawn on nearby impassable terrain, and W (Harsh Lesson) makes those Tentacles swing at you too on a 4-second cooldown. Fights fought against a wall are hers; fights fought in open lane strip most of her healing and burst. K'Sante doesn't win the laning phase, but his charge-up on W (Path Maker), his shield on E (Footwork), and a tank build that scales into Jak'Sho and Thornmail let him survive the wall-trades and flip the matchup by mid-game.

theirWindow.what: W (Harsh Lesson) leaps her in and makes nearby Tentacles swing at you too, healing her off every hit — don't initiate trades in these zones before level 6.

yourWindow.what: Build Q (Ntofo Strikes) to 2 stacks for the shockwave pull, drag her further from the wall, then commit W (Path Maker)'s stun while she has no tentacle sustain to fall back on.

start.why: The highest-pick path (87.8% pick, 61.1% WR over 36 games) — its sustain offsets Harsh Lesson's constant 4-second-cooldown poke before you have a shield or stun online.

boots.why: 78.4% pick and 58.6% WR over 29 games — Illaoi's damage is almost entirely physical autos and Tentacle hits, which Steelcaps directly reduces.

core.why: Armor against her physical damage plus regen reduction that starts cutting into her Tentacle-heal passive early.
The slow proc pairs with Q (Ntofo Strikes) so your 2-stack shockwave pull actually sticks before she can retreat to a wall.
Stacking resistances scale your tankiness the longer the fight runs, matching the matchup's late-game-favored shape.
Full Grievous Wounds shuts down her Tentacle-healing passive for good — the reason this exact path hit 100% over 4 games.

situational.when: she stacks lifesteal or heals heavily to out-sustain your poke
you're laning or grouping with a carry you need to redirect her damage onto you
you're grouping for teamfights and want to buff an ally fighting at your side

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp's bonus health and on-hit heal fight back against Harsh Lesson's repeated poke, and the extra max HP directly scales your trade damage against her.

summoners.why: Teleport covers the lane you're likely to lose early and lets you reset after a bad trade near her Tentacles instead of forcing a kill; Flash+Ignite (66.7% WR over fewer games) is the higher-upside pick if you're confident punishing her when she overextends off the wall.

playing.title: Fight away from walls
playing.detail: Tentacles only spawn on impassable terrain, and Harsh Lesson (W) makes nearby ones swing at you too — step off the wall before trading so her 4-second-cooldown leap doesn't double-dip damage and healing.

playing.title: Tank Test of Spirit, don't run
playing.detail: You only become a Vessel if the spirit (E, 900 range) is killed or you get too far from it — stand near it and let it expire instead of trying to burst it or disengage.

playing.title: Pull her off the wall with Q
playing.detail: Ntofo Strikes (Q) stacks on hit every 3.5 seconds; the shockwave at 2 stacks drags her into open lane, stripping her Tentacle support before you commit W (Path Maker).

playing.title: Save E for her W leap
playing.detail: Footwork (E) dashes and shields on a cooldown that drops from 10s to 8.5s as you rank it — hold it to shield through or reposition out of Harsh Lesson's range rather than burning it to poke.

playing.title: Avoid all-ins before level 6
playing.detail: Your trades even out once Iceborn Gauntlet and your first tank item are online — don't commit to a fight before this unless she's clearly overextended off her Tentacles.

playing.title: Rush the Grievous Wounds item
playing.detail: Her passive heals her off every Tentacle hit on a champion, so Bramble Vest into Thornmail cuts that sustain directly — it's the reason that exact path hit 100% in the sample.

playing.title: Use R to drag her off-wall
playing.detail: All Out (R) knocks her through terrain and away from her Tentacles while transforming your kit for the follow-up — accept the reduced defenses it costs to force a fight you control.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoner spells, and the 58.8% head-to-head win rate over 34 games come from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1); the tactical reading of Tentacles, walls, and ability timings is my own analysis.
